title: Catnip Shaders
description: This is my definitive way on how Minecraft should look.
body:
# Catnip-Shaders

This Shader makes Minecraft look as how I imagine the Best Version of it to look.

It adds:
- Shadows (with color)
- Fog
- Logic for the Darkness/Blindness effect
- Water and Lava Fog
- More vivid Colors
- Water Waves
- Dynamic Light (torches etc.)

### But what about Kiwi Shader?
This Shader is basically a KiwiShader V2. I rewrote it because i wanted something way different but with the same goal, to make my Version of Minecraft.


This Shader uses code from https://modrinth.com/shader/better-end-portal-shader for the end Portal.
